Historic Preservation Commission Agenda
  Municipal Services Building – 633 E. Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206

Welcome to the Historic Preservation Commission meeting. The Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout the week. Call (818)
548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office. Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing
anytime at http://www.ci.glendale.ca.us/agenda.aspx?OrganizationID=501. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please
contact the Community Development Department at (818) 548-2115 during regular business hours.

PLEASE TURN OFF ALL ELECTRONIC DEVICES WHILE INSIDE THE HEARING ROOM.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request.
Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign language
translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are
public records, will be available for review in the Community Development Department, 633 E. Broadway, RM 103, Glendale, CA 91206.

  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 19, 2019, 5:00 P.M.

  1. ROLL CALL – Chris Cragnotti, Nicholas Doom, Mike Morgan, Desiree Shier, Lorna Vartanian

  2. REPORT REGARDING POSTING OF AGENDA
  The agenda for this meeting was posted on or before Monday, September 16, 2019 on the bulletin board
  outside City Hall.

  3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  July 18, 2019

  4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is limited to 5 minutes. The
  Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  5. COMMENTS FROM COMMISSIONERS

  6. OLD BUSINESS
  a. 1106 Rossmoyne Avenue: Review of Owner Request to Maintain Existing Stucco and Delete the
  Previously Approved Mills Act Condition
  to be continued to HPC meeting of October 17, 2019

  7. NEW BUSINESS
  a. 1610 Cleveland Avenue: Advisory Design Review of proposed second floor addition and other
  alterations at property in the pending South Cumberland Heights Historic District
  b. 1208 Mariposa Street: Advisory Design Review of proposed second unit at rear of property identified
  as a historic resource in the South Glendale Historic Resource Survey
  c. 1427 Andenes Drive: Glendale Register Nomination and Mills Act Application
  d. 1390 Greenmont Drive: Glendale Register Nomination and Mills Act Application
  e. 1527 Cedarhill Road (GR No. 33): Mills Act Application

  8. PLANNING DIVISION UPDATES and INFORMATIONAL BRIEFINGS
  a. Update on Proposed South Cumberland Heights and Casa Verdugo Historic Districts Surveys
  b. Update on construction progress for new garage at 1753 Hillcrest

  9. ADJOURNMENT
minutes_text:
City of Glendale
  Historic Preservation Commission
  Municipal Services Building, Room 105
  633 East Broadway, CA 91206
  Action Minutes of Meeting
  Thursday, September 19, 2019

Meeting called to order by Chairperson Vartanian at 5:07 p.m.

1. Roll Call: Cragnotti, Doom, Morgan, Shier, Vartanian

2. The Agenda was posted on or before Monday, September 16, 2019.

3. Approval of Minutes: July 18, 2019

  Moved by: Commissioner Cragnotti
  Seconded: Commissioner Morgan

  Ayes:  Cragnotti, Doom, Morgan, Shier
  No:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Vartanian (Absent during last meeting)

4. Oral Communications: None

5. Comments from Commissioners:

    Commissioner Morgan announced the 135th anniversary celebration of Crescenta Valley on
  September 21st in St. Luke’s of the Mountains Church.

    Commissioner Doom announced another event from the days of Verdugo’s Heritage Association
  called“Fiestacita Mexican Dinner” on September 28th from 4 to 8 p.m. This event will take place in
  Historic Catalina Verdugo Adobe at 2211 Bonita Drive, Glendale.

6. Old Business
  a. 1106 Rossmoyne Avenue: Review of Owner Request to Maintain Existing Stucco and Delete the
  Previously Approved Mills Act Condition

  To be continued to October 17, 2019, HPC meeting

7. New Business
  a. 1610 Cleveland Avenue: Advisory Design Review of proposed second floor addition and other
  alterations at property in the pending South Cumberland Heights Historic District

  Speakers: Nareg Khodadadi (Applicant)
  Catherine Jurca (In Opposition)

  Written materials: Armen Dovlatian, Dr. Juliana P. Hazlett, and Francesca Smith.

  Advisory Vote:  Cragnotti, Doom, Morgan, Shier, Vartanian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None
 Historic Preservation Commission Minutes  2
September 19, 2019

  b. 1208 Mariposa Street: Advisory Design Review of proposed second unit at rear of property identified
  as a historic resource in the South Glendale Historic Resource Survey

  Speakers: Aydin Naghibi (Applicant)
  Catherine Jurca (In Opposition)

  Written material: Catherine Jurca (The Glendale Historical Society)

  Advisory Vote:  Cragnotti, Doom, Morgan, Shier, Vartanian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

  c. 1427 Andenes Drive: Glendale Register Nomination and Mills Act Application

  Motion to approve with conditions: Pursuant to Section 15.20.050 of the Glendale Municipal
  Code, the Historic Preservation Commission recommends to the City Council that the property at
  1427 Andenes Drive, to be known as “The Austin House”, be designated in the Glendale Register of
  Historic Resources, and that the City Council to authorize the City Manager to enter into a Mills Act
  contract with the property owners for Property tax savings.

  A Speaker: Victor Mazzone

  Moved by: Commissioner Shier
  Seconded: Commissioner Morgan

  Ayes:  Cragnotti, Doom, Morgan, Shier, Vartanian
  Noes: None
  Absent: None
  Abstain: None

  d. 1390 Greenmont Drive: Glendale Register Nomination and Mills Act Application

  Motion approved: Pursuant to Section 15.20.050 of the Glendale Municipal Code, the Historic
  Preservation Commission recommends to the City Council that the property at 1390 Greenmont
  Drive, known as “The John and JoAnn Taylor House” to be designated in the Glendale Register of
  Historic Resources, and that the City Council to authorize the City Manager to enter into a Mills Act
  contract with the property owners for Property tax savings.

  A Speaker: J. Brent Rice

  Moved by: Commissioner Morgan
  Seconded: Commissioner Shier

  Ayes:  Cragnotti, Doom, Morgan, Shier, Vartanian
  Noes: None
  Absent: None
  Abstain: None
 Historic Preservation Commission Minutes  3
September 19, 2019

  e. 1527 Cedarhill Road (GR No. 33): Mills Act Application

  To be continued to October 17, 2019, of HPC meeting.

PLANNING DIVISION UPDATES and INFORMATIONAL BRIEFINGS

  a. Update on Proposed South Cumberland Heights and Casa Verdugo Historic Districts Surveys

  Jay Platt stated that City Council approved the funding for this District, but the process will take
  about 8 months to bring it back to this commission, for their comments and inputs.

  b. Update on construction progress for new garage at 1753 Hillcrest

  Jay Platt will have more updates on October 17th meeting date.

  Adjournment: 7:54 p.m.

  ________________________________
  Chairperson – Historic Preservation Commission
